trans-unit.source: Add one or more IP addresses here. The visitor is logged in automatically if the remote address matches ANY of the configured IP addresses (OR logic).

We prefer to insert the full IPv4 or IPv6 address here. You can use * to mask IPv4 addresses: 192.168.*.*. In case of partly IPv6 addresses you have to insert the full address including mask: 2001:0db8:85a3:8a2e:0370:7334:0000:0000/96. If you don't add the mask we will use 128 which means: the complete IPv6 has to match.
